note: Game functions by name (SDK 16, hellforge_functions.h): each one's place in its module (rva), its first bytes as reviewed (code, an IDA-style pattern the loader checks before every use, through other hooks), its C signature and what each argument is. hook: true only where the signature is whole (every argument the function takes, unnamed ones as pass-through slots, and its return value), so a detour passes everything on; the others are for calling. The loader resolves them only on this build: a new game build revalidates every entry.

params.name: event
params.meaning: the DamageEvent: +0 target entity, +4 kind, +8 element, +0x10 dealer and +0x14 owner network ids, +0x18 creditor peer (u64), +0x2C amount (i32), +0x50 the hit position (3 floats)

ConsumeDamageEvent.meaning: Takes one damage event from this machine's queue in the frame's drain, before ApplyDamage's armour and multipliers. HF_ON_DAMAGE and HF_ON_DAMAGE_PRE come from it; a detour that changes the amount at +0x2C changes the damage
ConsumeDamageEvent.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-combat; HellForge's HF_ON_DAMAGE hook (event_sources.c)

params.name: creditor
params.meaning: the peer id the kill is credited to

params.name: dealer
params.meaning: the entity that dealt the killing damage

KillDispatch.meaning: Tells the game something was killed, on the victim's owner. HF_ON_KILL comes from it
KillDispatch.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-combat; HellForge's HF_ON_KILL hook (event_sources.c)

params.name: type
params.meaning: the StratagemType (HF_STRATAGEM_..., or a mod's from add_stratagem)

ActivateStratagemBeacon.meaning: Activates a stratagem's beacon once it lands, once per beacon, on the thrower's machine. HF_ON_STRATAGEM comes from it
ActivateStratagemBeacon.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-actions; HellForge's HF_ON_STRATAGEM hook (event_sources.c)

params.name: entity
params.meaning: the new entity's id in this session

params.name: resource
params.meaning: the entity's resource id (HF_ENTITY_..., or a mod's)

params.name: info
params.meaning: the SpawnInfo: +0 authority byte (1: this machine is in charge of it), +4 network id (u32)

SpawnEntity.meaning: Spawns an entity into this machine's world, remote spawns included. HF_ON_SPAWN comes from it, after the original returns
SpawnEntity.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-actions; HellForge's HF_ON_SPAWN hook (event_sources.c)

params.name: queue
params.meaning: the explosion queue: hf_global_ExplosionQueue (256 requests a frame)

params.name: creditor
params.meaning: the peer id its kills are credited to

RequestExplosion.meaning: Requests an explosion in this machine's world: projectile impacts, explosives, stratagems, chained blasts. HF_ON_EXPLOSION comes from it; hf->spawn_explosion is the checked way to call it
RequestExplosion.source: HD2Runtime 0.40.1 research event-explosions; HellForge's HF_ON_EXPLOSION hook (event_sources.c)

params.name: fraction
params.meaning: the share of its maximum health to add, to its health and every limb

AddHealthFraction.meaning: Heals an entity by a share of its maximum health. hf->heal is the checked way to call it

params.name: zone
params.meaning: the damage zone's name hash (a Helldiver's head 0x8C5570C9, torso 0xAA1DB0B0, arms 0x1880288E and 0xB6F2BAF5, legs 0x64A3FA1D and 0x87B05FF4)

RestoreZone.meaning: Restores one damage zone (a limb) to full. hf->heal_limb is the checked way to call it

params.name: buildup
params.meaning: how much of the status builds up

QueueStatusRequest.meaning: Queues a status buildup on an entity (4096 a frame: hf_global_CombatQueues' status_count). Host only. hf->apply_status is the checked way to call it

params.name: entity
params.meaning: the entity, which must have a motion record

SetVelocity.meaning: Sets an entity's velocity. hf->add_velocity is the checked way to push the local Helldiver

params.name: system
params.meaning: the projectile system: hf_global_ProjectileSystem (running while its running field is 1)

params.name: type
params.meaning: the ProjectileSettings row (HF_PROJECTILE_..., or a mod's)

FireProjectile.meaning: Fires a projectile. Host only, in a mission, with the projectile's package loaded. hf->spawn_projectile is the checked way to call it
